name: Pass Go
text: Draw 2 cards.

name: Deal Breaker
text: Steal a complete property set.

name: Forced Deal
text: Swap one of your properties with an opponent property outside a complete set.

name: Sly Deal
text: Steal a property outside a complete set.

name: Just Say No
text: Cancel an action played against you.

name: Debt Collector
text: One opponent pays you 5M.

name: It’s My Birthday
text: Every other player pays you 2M.

name: Double the Rent
text: Play with rent to double rent; uses an additional card play.

name: House
text: Add to a complete color set for +3M rent. Not railroads or utilities.

name: Hotel
text: Add after a House for another +4M rent. Not railroads or utilities.

name: Eviction Notice
text: Return one opponent property to their hand, including from a complete set. That card cannot be played again this turn.

name: Forced Rezoning
text: Permanently lock an opponent wildcard to one of its allowed colors, including after ownership changes.

name: Compulsory Purchase
text: Opponent pays you at least 5M in properties only, of their choice; no change. If insufficient, pay all eligible properties.

name: Luxury Tax
text: Every other player discards 5M per complete set they own. Bank first, then properties. Activating player exempt. Just Say No protects only its user.

name: Tough Luck
text: Target an opponent with at least one complete property set. Take all cards of your chosen category (Property, Action, or Money) from their hand.

name: Money 1M
text: Bank money; no change when paying.

name: Money 2M
text: Bank money; no change when paying.

name: Money 3M
text: Bank money; no change when paying.

name: Money 4M
text: Bank money; no change when paying.

name: Money 5M
text: Bank money; no change when paying.

name: Money 10M
text: Bank money; no change when paying.

name: Rent Brown Light Blue
text: Any Color targets one opponent; two-color rent targets every other player.

name: Rent Pink Orange
text: Any Color targets one opponent; two-color rent targets every other player.

name: Rent Red Yellow
text: Any Color targets one opponent; two-color rent targets every other player.

name: Rent Dark Blue Green
text: Any Color targets one opponent; two-color rent targets every other player.

name: Rent Railroad Utility
text: Any Color targets one opponent; two-color rent targets every other player.

name: Rent Any Color
text: Any Color targets one opponent; two-color rent targets every other player.

name: Pink Orange Wildcard
text: Two colors in opposing orientations; rent follows assigned color.

name: Multicolor Wildcard
text: Any property color. Cannot be banked or used as payment.

name: Brown Light Blue Wildcard
text: Reversible dual-color wildcard. Use the assigned color rent table.

name: Light Blue Railroad Wildcard
text: Reversible dual-color wildcard. Use the assigned color rent table.

name: Red Yellow Wildcard
text: Reversible dual-color wildcard. Use the assigned color rent table.

name: Dark Blue Green Wildcard
text: Reversible dual-color wildcard. Use the assigned color rent table.

name: Green Railroad Wildcard
text: Reversible dual-color wildcard. Use the assigned color rent table.

name: Railroad Utility Wildcard
text: Reversible dual-color wildcard. Use the assigned color rent table.

name: Corporate Headquarters
text: Play up to 4 cards per turn instead of 3.

name: Private Vault
text: Your end-of-turn hand limit is 9. Start your turn with an empty hand: draw 7 instead of 5.

name: Luxury District
text: Add 1M to each opponent’s rent bill.

name: Rent-Controlled Residence
text: Reduce rent you owe by 2M, minimum 0M.

name: Investment Office
text: Draw 3 cards instead of 2 at the start of your turn. An empty hand still draws 5.

name: Insurance Agency
text: Draw 1 card per property taken or surrendered to pay another player, after resolution. Includes special properties.

name: I Owe You
text: Give this card from your hand to the creditor instead of paying them. If blocked by Just Say No, discard this card; the original bill remains due.

name: Emergency Treasury
text: At the start of your turn, if your bank is below 20M, add a 3M money card to your bank.

name: Go to Jail
text: Choose an opponent. At the start of their next turn, discard 10M from bank/field or skip that turn.

name: Expansion Property
text: Join an existing color set with space. Its color locks while you own it; a new owner chooses an existing set. Discard if no non-Expansion property of its color remains.

name: Free Parking
text: Once per turn, bank one card without spending an action.

name: Community Chest
text: Free action: draw 2; every other player draws 1.

name: Chance
text: Free action: reveal top 3, keep 1, discard the other 2.

name: Empire Rent
text: One opponent pays 1M for each property on your field, including special properties.

name: Income Tax
text: Choose an opponent and that player discards 3M per 10M in their bank.

name: Bank Withdrawal
text: Take one action card from your bank into your hand. This is a free action.
